svg.title: The pattern walk: Op-art geometric
svg.desc: The pattern walk (2D): on the other side, seen from high above, every tree stands exactly where a lost thing stood, so each lost campsite is a glyph of trees: the post, four table corners, a ring for the fire, a square tent pad. Tam stands on glyph 18 with three candidate glyphs ahead; only one shows the detail Tam wrote for site 17, a wheel of saplings and a crooked pad, and the regular rhythm of the trees leads to it. A wrong step whites out and returns Tam to the last true glyph.
